name: Dai-Dan Co.
summary: Dai-Dan Co., Ltd., established in Osaka, Japan in 1903 (and known as Osaka Denki Danbo Co., Ltd. until 1987), serves as a leading specialist in the design, oversight, and construction of essential building infrastructure throughout Japan. Their core competencies span electrical systems, advanced air conditioning, plumbing and sanitary installations, and firefighting facilities. The company delivers a wide array of innovative solutions focused on optimizing efficiency, enhancing comfort, and creating specialized environments. These include Artificial Intelligence applications for energy conservation, the REMOVIS platform for comprehensive building equipment monitoring and management, and WIT WET vaporization humidification systems. They are also adept in Net Zero Energy Building (NZEB) solutions, specialized climate control systems for experimental animal breeding (such as Airac System and Lami Flowrack), and advanced air conditioning units like Arapak (an internal automatic cleaning package AC) and Econospot (a targeted spot air-conditioning system), in addition to all-in-one CP units. Dai-Dan's portfolio further encompasses environmental control technologies like Ion Drop for static electricity removal, Air Barrier Booths for preventing cross-contamination, air filter regeneration services, and detailed airflow analysis. They also offer comfort-focused products such as air conditioning chairs and cushion ducky, alongside various humidifiers, lightweight reinforced ducts, and sealing-free solutions. Their expertise extends to sophisticated systems including stratified air conditioning, heat storage tanks, energy-saving dehumidification systems, virtual duct clean room systems, room pressure control barriers, and anticorrosion diagnostic services. To boost HVAC efficiency, they offer FlowSmart for reducing air conditioning equipment transport power, radiant air conditioning for precise room temperature regulation, and floor blowing air conditioning systems. Additionally, Dai-Dan undertakes general machinery and equipment installation projects.
